expected_return.window: scorebord: BUY 13:30 ET on the entry day; SELL amc at the next open, bmo at 13:00 ET on the report day; gross

note: Each member is reported as a percentile of its own live range, 0-100 (pct), with its direction in side; panel_pct (0-100) is the size of the mean of the signed percentiles and side its direction; panel_pct_sd their spread. The selection is panel_pct in the top 20%. panel_score is the signed median of the members' sizes, each read against its own recent history. consensus_k counts members that put the name in their own top 20% on the panel's side; that, not sign agreement, is what selected well on the development names. Certainty (p_up) is recorded and decides nothing. expected_edge_pct is a shrunk in-sample prior, not a forecast. Research only.

opus5.note: Item 1 is the only real evidence: three direct peers (QFIN -21.9% QoQ volume and -73% YoY profit with Q4 guided down another 20%, FINV mainland volume -66.8% YoY and profit -51.8% QoQ, LX guiding a possible Q3 loss) all printed after XYF last spoke on 2026-08-24, so a Q3 well below the RMB993.6m/RMB47.0m run-rate is likely and XYF has not repriced (+0.38% on 11-25 while QFIN fell 7.6%); but it is proxy transmission with an unsourced bar (no consensus exists), item 4 offsets part of it on sequentially improving delinquency, and item 0 is why the number stays small rather than being a finding - the stock is a merger-arb spread to the controller's US$6.03 bid, the 93.45%-voting bidder made that bid on 2026-11-06 already knowing the completed Q3, and a deal-pinned ADS trading 12.9% below a no-financing-condition offer reprices on deal news, not on the quarter, so abs_move 6.0 (one day of 86% realised vol, thin 100k ADS/day) with p_up only modestly below 50.

opus55.note: Stock trades the US$6.03 controller bid spread (12.9%), so the peer-implied weak Q3 (item 1, a proxy against an unsourced bar) is only a small negative, partly offset by credit stabilisation and a possible deal-progress line; near non-result.

sonnet55.note: XYF is pinned to a controller take-private bid (US$6.03, spot 12.9% below), so peer Q3 funding-squeeze read-through (QFIN, FINV, LX; item 1) leans modestly down on an unsourced bar, partly offset by credit stabilisation (item 4); no history, no options, bid caps the move.

fable51.note: Rests on item 1 (QFIN/FINV Q3 prints after XYF last spoke imply volume and revenue well below the Q2 run-rate with loss risk, a proxy on an unsourced bar so capped), damped by item 0 (the $6.03 controller bid, 12.9% spread, anchors the stock and caps the move, so abs_move is set below the 5.4% realised-vol deadband and the sign lean stays at the proxy band); items 2-4 are small offsets.
